title: Derek Lassiter’s “Years & Years” is a timeless reflection on resilience and self love
htmlContent:
Derek Lassiter's newest song, "Years & Years," is a beautiful reflection on resilience, self-love, and the passage of time. Mixing elements of folk, soul, and country music, Lassiter creates a sound that feels both personal and vast.

His voice is warm and rich, conveying deep emotions with each line, making it feel more like a heartfelt conversation than a typical performance. The music is simple yet impactful, allowing the genuine feelings to shine through. A soft acoustic guitar sets the stage, while gentle melodies add depth. Everyone faces the challenges of time and learns to love themselves through good times and bad.

https://open.spotify.com/track/1Pxzx2feKNaRklEBzBluoU?si=Ogh51SeiRmWoLVYzB4uQZQ

Lassiter doesn't pretend that this journey is easy, but he offers comfort and understanding, reminding us that there is beauty in overcoming struggles. This song reminds us that resilience means facing setbacks and finding the strength to get back up repeatedly. Derek Lassiter sings about the meaningful moments that shape our lives.
